examTags: 语法·形容词与动词辨义
grammar: adj. 健康的、健壮的；v. 适合。作形容词可说 keep/stay fit；作动词时可用 fit for sth.。
collocations: keep fit；stay fit；fit for a sport
commonMistake: fit 可表示“健康的”或“合适的”；不要与表示“合身”的动词用法混淆。

example.english: I swim every week to stay fit.
example.chinese: 我每周游泳以保持健康。

application.prompt: Regular exercise helps you stay healthy and strong. It helps you stay ___. (fit / tall)
application.solution: fit。解析：健康、强壮对应 fit（健康的）。

grammar: n. 棒球；棒球运动。表示运动项目时通常不加冠词，常用 play baseball。
collocations: play baseball；a baseball game；baseball player
commonMistake: 表示参加棒球运动说 play baseball，不说 play a baseball；a baseball 通常指一个棒球。

example.english: Our class plays baseball after school on Friday.
example.chinese: 我们班星期五放学后打棒球。

application.prompt: Players hit a ball with a bat in this sport. They play ___. (baseball / badminton)
application.solution: baseball。解析：用球棒击球的运动是棒球。

grammar: n. 手套；可数名词，复数 gloves。通常一只手套用 a glove，一双手套用 a pair of gloves。
collocations: a baseball glove；a pair of gloves；put on a glove
commonMistake: glove 是可数名词；表示一双时说 a pair of gloves，注意 gloves 用复数。

example.english: Ben wears a glove to catch the ball.
example.chinese: 本戴着手套接球。

application.prompt: You wear a ___ on your hand to protect it when catching a ball. (glove / mat)
application.solution: glove。解析：接球时戴在手上的装备是手套。

grammar: n. 垫子；可数名词，复数 mats。常指运动或锻炼时铺在地上的垫子。
collocations: an exercise mat；a yoga mat；on the mat
commonMistake: mat 是可数名词，单数前通常要有 a/the 等限定词。

example.english: Put the exercise mat on the floor before doing sit-ups.
example.chinese: 做仰卧起坐前把运动垫铺在地上。

application.prompt: Put the exercise ___ on the floor before doing sit-ups. (mat / racket)
application.solution: mat。解析：锻炼时铺在地上的垫子是 exercise mat。

grammar: n. 绳子；可数名词，复数 ropes。表达一段绳子可说 a piece of rope。
collocations: a piece of rope；hold a rope；jump rope
commonMistake: rope 是可数名词；表示一段绳子时可说 a piece of rope。

example.english: We use a rope to mark the edge of the practice area.
example.chinese: 我们用一根绳子标出练习区域的边界。

application.prompt: Use a ___ to tie the two sports bags together. (rope / racket)
application.solution: rope。解析：可以用来捆扎物品的是绳子。

grammar: 短语。可指跳绳运动或跳绳用的绳子；jump rope 作运动表达时常见于美式英语，英式英语也常说 skip。
collocations: jump rope for exercise；a jump rope；use a jump rope
commonMistake: jump rope 可指运动，也可指跳绳用的绳子；表达“跳绳运动”时不要说 play a jump rope。

example.english: The children jump rope in the playground after class.
example.chinese: 孩子们下课后在操场跳绳。

application.prompt: The children use a long rope to jump over again and again. They are doing ___. (jump rope / baseball)
application.solution: jump rope。解析：用绳子反复跳跃的运动是跳绳。

grammar: n. 球拍；可数名词，复数 rackets。可用于网球、羽毛球等球类运动。
collocations: a tennis racket；a badminton racket；hold a racket
commonMistake: racket 是可数名词；说一支球拍用 a racket，说两支用 two rackets。

example.english: Mia brings her badminton racket to practice.
example.chinese: 米娅带着羽毛球拍去练习。

application.prompt: In badminton, players hit the shuttlecock with a ___. (racket / glove)
application.solution: racket。解析：羽毛球运动中用球拍击打羽毛球。

grammar: adv. 几乎不；几乎没有。hardly 本身带否定含义，通常放在实义动词前、be 动词后。
collocations: hardly know；hardly any；hardly ever
commonMistake: hardly 已有“几乎不”的否定含义，通常不再与 not 连用；hardly anyone 表示“几乎没有人”。

example.english: There is hardly anyone in the gym this morning.
example.chinese: 今天早上体育馆里几乎没有人。

application.prompt: The gym is almost empty; ___ anyone is there. (hardly / loudly)
application.solution: hardly。解析：hardly anyone 表示“几乎没有人”。

grammar: adv. 曾经；在任何时候。常用于疑问句或否定语境；询问人生经历时常用 Have you ever + 过去分词?。
collocations: Have you ever...?；hardly ever；ever before
commonMistake: 询问是否“曾经”做过某事时，ever 常放在 have/has 后、过去分词前；不要与 never 重复表达同一否定。

example.english: Have you ever played badminton at school?
example.chinese: 你曾在学校打过羽毛球吗？

application.prompt: Ask about any time in a friend’s life: Have you ___ played badminton in your life? (ever / yesterday)
application.solution: ever。解析：ever 可用于现在完成时疑问句询问人生经历；yesterday 是明确过去时间，不能放在此现在完成时句中。

grammar: 短语，频率副词，表示“几乎从不”。通常放在实义动词前；放在 be 动词后。
collocations: hardly ever play；hardly ever go；be hardly ever late
commonMistake: hardly ever 本身有否定意义，不再加 not；主语为第三人称单数时，后面的实义动词仍需按主语变化。

example.english: Ella hardly ever misses baseball practice.
example.chinese: 埃拉几乎从不缺席棒球训练。

application.prompt: He plays badminton only once or twice a year, so he ___ plays it. (hardly ever / often)
application.solution: hardly ever。解析：一年只打几次，表示几乎不常打。

sources.label: Cambridge Grammar: hardly ever, rarely, scarcely, seldom

grammar: adv. 一次；曾经；conj. 一旦、当……时。表示频率时常见 once a week（每周一次）。
collocations: once a week；once again；once upon a time
commonMistake: once 表示“一次”时可与次数频率搭配；不要与 twice（两次）混淆。

example.english: Our team practises once a week.
example.chinese: 我们队每周训练一次。

application.prompt: We practise one time a week, so we practise ___ a week. (once / twice)
application.solution: once。解析：one time 对应 once，表示一次。

grammar: adv. 两次；两倍。表示频率时可说 twice a week；表示倍数时常用 twice as + 形容词/副词 + as。
collocations: twice a week；twice a day；twice as many
commonMistake: twice 表示“两次”，不说 two times 也可以，但次数表达中 twice 更简洁；不要与 once 混淆。

example.english: Our volleyball team practises twice a week.
example.chinese: 我们的排球队每周训练两次。

application.prompt: We practise on Monday and Thursday, so we train ___ a week. (twice / once)
application.solution: twice。解析：一周训练两次用 twice a week。

grammar: pron. 我的（所有物）；名词性物主代词，可独立代替“my + 名词”，不直接放在名词前。
collocations: be mine；a friend of mine；mine and yours
commonMistake: mine 后不直接接名词；说“我的球拍”用 my racket，说“球拍是我的”用 The racket is mine。

example.english: My racket is blue, but the black one is mine.
example.chinese: 我的球拍是蓝色的，但黑色的那支是我的。

application.prompt: This is my racket. It is ___. (mine / my)
application.solution: mine。解析：be 动词后独立表示“我的”，用名词性物主代词 mine。

examTags: 语法·形容词性与名词性物主代词
grammar: pron. 她的（所有物）；名词性物主代词，独立使用代替“her + 名词”。
collocations: be hers；a friend of hers；hers and mine
commonMistake: hers 后不接名词；her racket 中用形容词性物主代词 her，The racket is hers 中用 hers。

example.english: My glove is blue, and the red one is hers.
example.chinese: 我的手套是蓝色的，红色的那只手套是她的。

application.prompt: The red glove belongs to Lucy. It is ___. (hers / her)
application.solution: hers。解析：句末独立表示“她的”，用名词性物主代词 hers。

grammar: adv. 也许；大概。可放在句首或主语前，修饰整个句子；may be 是情态动词 may 加 be。
collocations: maybe later；maybe not；maybe tomorrow
commonMistake: maybe 是一个副词，表示“也许”；may be 是两个词，如 It may be true。

example.english: Maybe our team will practise after lunch.
example.chinese: 也许我们队午饭后会训练。

application.prompt: ___ it will rain after practice, so take a jacket. (Maybe / May be)
application.solution: Maybe。解析：句子需要表示“也许”的副词 maybe。

grammar: adj. 使用得多的；常用的。作复合形容词修饰名词时常写作带连字符的 well-used。
collocations: a well-used skateboard；well-used equipment；a well-used path
commonMistake: 注意拼写 well-used 中有连字符；well-used 表示“使用得多的”，不等同于 new。

example.english: The well-used skateboard has a few marks on it.
example.chinese: 这块常用的滑板上有几处痕迹。

application.prompt: This ___ skateboard has been used many times. (well-used / well use)
application.solution: well-used。解析：修饰名词 skateboard 的复合形容词写作 well-used。

grammar: n. 练习；实践。可表示训练活动或反复练习；作不可数名词时可说 more practice。
collocations: baseball practice；get more practice；practice match
commonMistake: 本词条 practice 作名词；在英式英语中，表示“练习”这个动词通常拼作 practise。

example.english: Our team needs more practice before the match.
example.chinese: 比赛前我们队还需要更多练习。

application.prompt: The team needs more ___ before the match. (practice / practise)
application.solution: practice。解析：more 后此处需要名词“练习”；英式英语名词拼作 practice。

grammar: adj. 完美的；极好的。可作定语修饰名词，也可作表语。
collocations: a perfect score；perfect for；a perfect day
commonMistake: perfect 是形容词，可修饰名词或用于 be 动词后；修饰动词通常用 perfectly。

example.english: The team made a perfect score in the skills test.
example.chinese: 这支队伍在技能测试中取得了满分。

application.prompt: She made no mistakes, so her performance was ___. (perfect / seldom)
application.solution: perfect。解析：没有犯错说明表现完美，用形容词 perfect。

grammar: adv. 很少；不常。表示低频，通常放在实义动词前、be 动词后。
collocations: seldom play；seldom go；seldom late
commonMistake: seldom 本身有否定意味，通常不与 not 连用；表示频率时注意动词仍按主语变化。

example.english: Our team seldom plays on rainy days.
example.chinese: 我们队很少在下雨天比赛。

application.prompt: He plays only once in several months, so he ___ joins the games. (seldom / often)
application.solution: seldom。解析：几个月才参加一次，表示很少参加。

grammar: n. 羽毛球运动。表示运动项目时通常作不可数名词，常用 play badminton。
collocations: play badminton；a badminton racket；badminton club
commonMistake: 表示打羽毛球说 play badminton，不加 a；表示球拍时说 a badminton racket。

example.english: We play badminton in the school gym on Fridays.
example.chinese: 我们每周五在学校体育馆打羽毛球。

application.prompt: Players hit a shuttlecock over a net with rackets in ___. (badminton / baseball)
application.solution: badminton。解析：使用羽毛球拍和羽毛球的运动是 badminton。

grammar: n. 双打；adj. 双的；两倍的。作形容词时可修饰名词，表示两倍或成双。
collocations: double the number；a double room；play doubles
commonMistake: double 可作形容词表示“两倍的”；表达网球双打项目时常用 doubles。

example.english: The doubles match has two players on each side.
example.chinese: 双打比赛中每一方有两名选手。

application.prompt: An amount that is two times another amount is ___ it. (double / single)
application.solution: double。解析：double 可表示“是……的两倍”。

grammar: adv. 在某个时候。表示时间不确定但大致在某段时间内；sometimes 表示“有时”，some time 表示“一段时间”。
collocations: sometime tomorrow；sometime next week；meet sometime
commonMistake: sometime（某个时候）、sometimes（有时）、some time（一段时间）含义和词形不同。

example.english: Let us go jogging sometime next week.
example.chinese: 我们下周找个时候去慢跑吧。

application.prompt: We can meet ___ next week; we will choose the day later. (sometime / sometimes)
application.solution: sometime。解析：这里指下周某个不确定的时间，用 sometime。

grammar: n. 排球；排球运动。表示运动项目时通常不加冠词，常用 play volleyball。
collocations: play volleyball；a volleyball team；a volleyball match
commonMistake: 表示参加排球运动说 play volleyball；指一个排球时才说 a volleyball。

example.english: Our volleyball team practises twice a week.
example.chinese: 我们的排球队每周训练两次。

application.prompt: Players hit a large ball over a net with their hands in ___. (volleyball / jogging)
application.solution: volleyball。解析：隔网用手击球的运动是排球。

grammar: pron. 他们的；她们的；它们的（所有物）。名词性物主代词，独立代替“their + 名词”。
collocations: be theirs；a friend of theirs；theirs and ours
commonMistake: theirs 后不接名词；说“他们的球拍”用 their racket，说“球拍是他们的”用 theirs。

example.english: These volleyballs are theirs, and those are ours.
example.chinese: 这些排球是他们的，那些是我们的。

application.prompt: Those balls belong to them. The balls are ___. (theirs / their)
application.solution: theirs。解析：句末独立表示“他们的”，用名词性物主代词 theirs。

grammar: v. 慢跑。规则变化时常双写 g：jog—jogged—jogged；现在分词为 jogging。
collocations: jog around the park；go jogging；jog for exercise
commonMistake: jog 的过去式为 jogged，现在分词为 jogging，词尾 g 要双写。

example.english: I jog around the park twice a week.
example.chinese: 我每周绕公园慢跑两次。

application.prompt: They are ___ in the park now. (jogging / joging)
application.solution: jogging。解析：jog 的现在分词要双写 g，再加 -ing。

grammar: adj.（表示否定的）很少的；几乎没有的。修饰可数名词复数，常带“数量少、不够”的语气。
collocations: few players；very few people；few of the students
commonMistake: few 用于可数名词复数；few（很少，语气偏否定）与 a few（有一些）意思不同。

example.english: Few players came, so we could not make two teams.
example.chinese: 来的选手很少，所以我们组不成两支队伍。

application.prompt: There are very ___ players today, so we cannot make two teams. (few / much)
application.solution: few。解析：players 是可数名词复数，用 few；much 修饰不可数名词。

grammar: 短语，少数；几个；一些。后接可数名词复数，语气通常表示“有一些”。
collocations: a few players；a few times；just a few
commonMistake: a few 后接可数名词复数；a few 表示“有一些”，few 更强调“很少、不够”。

example.english: A few students stayed to practise after class.
example.chinese: 有几个学生留在课后练习。

application.prompt: There are ___ students ready to play—three of them. (a few / a little)
application.solution: a few。解析：students 是可数名词复数，用 a few；a little 修饰不可数名词。

sources.label: Cambridge Dictionary: few and a few

grammar: v. 原谅；宽恕。可用 excuse sb. for sth./doing sth. 表示因某事原谅某人。
collocations: excuse me；excuse sb. for being late；excuse a mistake
commonMistake: excuse 作动词时可直接接人作宾语；礼貌打断或请求注意时常说 Excuse me。

example.english: Please excuse me for arriving late to practice.
example.chinese: 请原谅我训练迟到了。

application.prompt: Please ___ me for being late. (excuse / excuses)
application.solution: excuse。解析：祈使句以动词原形开头。

grammar: 交际短语。可用于礼貌地引起注意、请求让路或打断谈话，也可用于轻微道歉。
collocations: Excuse me, ...；Excuse me for ...；Excuse me, could you...?
commonMistake: Excuse me 常用来礼貌引起注意或请求；表达较直接的道歉时也可用 I am sorry。

example.english: Excuse me, could you show me the way to the gym?
example.chinese: 劳驾，您能告诉我去体育馆的路吗？

application.prompt: You want to ask someone for directions politely. Start with “___, could you help me?” (Excuse me / Goodbye)
application.solution: Excuse me。解析：礼貌引起对方注意时可说 Excuse me。

grammar: 短语，在那边；表示说话人认为离自己较远的位置。常放在 be 动词后或句末。
collocations: over there；go over there；the gym over there
commonMistake: over there 指较远处；over here 指靠近说话人的地方。

example.english: The badminton courts are over there, beside the gym.
example.chinese: 羽毛球场在那边，体育馆旁边。

application.prompt: The gym is across the yard, beside the blue door. It is ___. (over there / over here)
application.solution: over there。解析：体育馆在院子对面，指较远的位置用 over there。

grammar: adv. 只是；正好。常放在所修饰的词语前；具体含义需结合上下文判断。
collocations: just one；just enough；just now
commonMistake: just 可表示“只是”或“正好”；不要仅凭词形把它当作形容词。

example.english: It is just a practice game, not the final match.
example.chinese: 这只是一场练习赛，不是决赛。

application.prompt: There is one ball and no others; we have ___ one ball. (just / seldom)
application.solution: just。解析：这里 just 表示“仅仅、只有”。

examTags: 书写·复合词大小写与连字符
grammar: n. T 恤衫；可数名词，复数 T-shirts。词头按教材写法保留大写 T 和连字符。
collocations: wear a T-shirt；a white T-shirt；T-shirt and shorts
commonMistake: T-shirt 中 T 要大写并保留连字符；单数前通常要有 a/the 等限定词。

example.english: Steve wears a blue T-shirt for the team photo.
example.chinese: 史蒂夫拍队伍合照时穿着一件蓝色 T 恤。

application.prompt: He is wearing a blue ___ with black shorts. (T-shirt / T-shirts)
application.solution: T-shirt。解析：a blue 后接单数可数名词 T-shirt。

grammar: v. 应在（某处）；属于。表示某物应在适当位置可用 belong in/on；表示所属关系常用 belong to。
collocations: belong in the box；belong on the shelf；belong to a team
commonMistake: belong 常与介词搭配；表示所属用 belong to，不能漏掉 to。

example.english: This racket belongs in the equipment box after practice.
example.chinese: 训练后这支球拍应该放回器材箱里。

application.prompt: This racket ___ in the equipment box after practice. (belongs / belong)
application.solution: belongs。解析：主语 This racket 是第三人称单数，一般现在时谓语加 -s。

grammar: 短语，属于（某人或某组织）。belong to 后接所有者或所属团体。
collocations: belong to me；belong to a club；belong to our school
commonMistake: 表示“属于某人”用 belong to sb.；不要说 belong someone。

example.english: The blue volleyball belongs to our school team.
example.chinese: 这个蓝色排球属于我们校队。

application.prompt: This ball ___ our team; its name is written on it. (belongs to / belongs)
application.solution: belongs to。解析：belongs 后直接接名词不完整，表示所属要用 belongs to。

grammar: adj. 工作的；从事工作的。可放在名词前修饰人或事物，如 working parents。
collocations: working parents；working people；working life
commonMistake: working 作形容词修饰名词；work 可作名词或动词，需根据句子位置选择词形。

example.english: My working parents exercise with me in the evening.
example.chinese: 我工作的父母晚上和我一起锻炼。

application.prompt: My ___ parents both go to work every day. (working / work)
application.solution: working。解析：parents 前需要形容词修饰，用 working。

grammar: 短语，工作日；可数名词短语，复数 working days。具体哪些日子属于工作日可能因地区和安排而不同。
collocations: on a working day；five working days；working day starts
commonMistake: working day 是“工作日”，weekend 是“周末”；复数形式为 working days。

example.english: The sports centre opens early on working days.
example.chinese: 体育中心在工作日开放得比较早。

application.prompt: Monday to Friday are usually ___ for this office; Saturday and Sunday are the weekend. (working days / weekends)
application.solution: working days。解析：该办公室周一至周五上班，这些日子是工作日。

grammar: 短语，充满；有许多。常用 be full of + 名词。
collocations: be full of energy；full of people；a bag full of balls
commonMistake: 固定搭配是 full of，不说 full with。

example.english: The gym is full of students before the match.
example.chinese: 比赛前体育馆里挤满了学生。

application.prompt: The gym is ___ students, so there is no space left. (full of / full with)
application.solution: full of。解析：固定搭配为 be full of。

grammar: n. 精力；能量。表示精力时通常作不可数名词；可说 a lot of energy、enough energy。
collocations: full of energy；enough energy；save energy
commonMistake: 表示精力时 energy 通常不可数，不说 many energies；量多用 much/a lot of。

example.english: I have enough energy to jog after school.
example.chinese: 我有足够的精力放学后慢跑。

application.prompt: After a good night’s sleep, I have enough ___ to practise. (energy / rope)
application.solution: energy。解析：足够的体力或精力用 energy 表示。

grammar: n. 组；群。可数名词，常用 a group of + 复数名词表示一组人或物。
collocations: a group of students；work in groups；a small group
commonMistake: group 是可数名词；单数时说 a group，表达成员用 a group of + 复数名词。

example.english: A group of students practises volleyball after class.
example.chinese: 一组学生课后练习排球。

application.prompt: A ___ of four students practises together. (group / energy)
application.solution: group。解析：四名学生组成一组，可说 a group of students。

grammar: n. 滑板；可数名词，常见搭配是 ride a skateboard。
collocations: ride a skateboard；a skateboard park；skateboard tricks
commonMistake: skateboard 是可数名词；表示玩滑板时常说 ride a skateboard。

example.english: Liam rides his skateboard in the park after school.
example.chinese: 利亚姆放学后在公园里玩滑板。

application.prompt: You ride on a board with wheels called a ___. (skateboard / racket)
application.solution: skateboard。解析：带轮子的滑板叫 skateboard。

grammar: v. 鼓励；激励。常用 encourage sb. to do sth. 表示鼓励某人做某事。
collocations: encourage sb. to practise；encourage a friend；encourage teamwork
commonMistake: 常用 encourage sb. to do sth.；不漏掉 to。

example.english: Our coach encourages us to practise safely.
example.chinese: 我们的教练鼓励我们安全地练习。

application.prompt: Our coach encourages us ___ regularly. (to practise / practise)
application.solution: to practise。解析：结构为 encourage sb. to do sth.。

grammar: n. 技巧；戏法。可数名词，复数 tricks；运动语境中可指一项技巧或动作。
collocations: learn a trick；do a trick；a skateboard trick
commonMistake: trick 是可数名词，单数前通常要有 a/the 等限定词。

example.english: The skateboarder learned a new trick at the park.
example.chinese: 那位滑板运动员在公园学会了一个新技巧。

application.prompt: The skateboarder learned a new ___ to perform safely. (trick / progress)
application.solution: trick。解析：可以学习并完成的一项动作技巧是 trick。

grammar: v. 成功；达到目标。常用 succeed in sth./doing sth.；过去式和过去分词为 succeeded。
collocations: succeed in a match；succeed in doing sth.；succeed at school
commonMistake: 表示“成功做某事”用 succeed in doing，不说 succeed to do。

example.english: She hopes to succeed in reaching her goal.
example.chinese: 她希望成功实现自己的目标。

application.prompt: With regular practice, she hopes to ___ in reaching her goal. (succeed / success)
application.solution: succeed。解析：to 后需接动词原形，succeed 是动词。

grammar: n. 滑板运动。表示进行这项活动可说 go skateboarding；作运动名称时通常不加冠词。
collocations: go skateboarding；skateboarding park；skateboarding lesson
commonMistake: 表示去玩滑板常说 go skateboarding；skateboard 是动词或器材名，不能说 play skateboard。

example.english: We go skateboarding at the park after school.
example.chinese: 我们放学后去公园玩滑板。

application.prompt: On Saturday, we go ___ at the new park. (skateboarding / skateboard)
application.solution: skateboarding。解析：go 后接活动名称 skateboarding。

grammar: n. 目标；目的；（球赛中的）进球。可数名词，常用 set/reach a goal。
collocations: set a goal；reach a goal；score a goal
commonMistake: goal 可指想达到的目标，也可指比赛中的进球；根据上下文判断。

example.english: My goal is to improve my balance this month.
example.chinese: 我的目标是这个月提高平衡能力。

application.prompt: Something you work hard to achieve is a ___. (goal / mat)
application.solution: goal。解析：努力想要实现的结果是目标。

grammar: n. 仰卧起坐；可数名词，复数 sit-ups。常与 do 连用。
collocations: do sit-ups；ten sit-ups；sit-up exercise
commonMistake: 表示做仰卧起坐用 do sit-ups；复数拼写在 sit-up 后加 -s。

example.english: I do ten sit-ups after jogging.
example.chinese: 我慢跑后做十个仰卧起坐。

application.prompt: One floor exercise in which you raise your upper body from lying down is a ___. (sit-up / racket)
application.solution: sit-up。解析：这种健身动作叫 sit-up（仰卧起坐）。

grammar: 短语动词，锻炼；健身。作动词短语时分写 work out；其名词形式 workout 通常合写。
collocations: work out at the gym；work out regularly；work out twice a week
commonMistake: 动词短语写作 work out；名词“锻炼”常写作 workout。

example.english: Our team works out at the gym twice a week.
example.chinese: 我们队每周在体育馆锻炼两次。

application.prompt: I ___ at the gym three times a week to exercise. (work out / work on)
application.solution: work out。解析：work out 可表示锻炼身体。

grammar: n. 应用程序，是 application 的常用缩略形式；可数名词，复数 apps。
collocations: a fitness app；download an app；use an app
commonMistake: app 以元音音素开头，单数前用 an：an app。

example.english: Our team uses an app to record practice times.
example.chinese: 我们队用一个应用程序记录训练时间。

application.prompt: A small program on a phone is an ___. (app / team)
application.solution: app。解析：手机上的应用程序常称为 app。

examTags: 语言·描述学习与训练成果
grammar: n. 进步；进展。通常作不可数名词；常用 make progress、make progress in doing sth.。
collocations: make progress；steady progress；progress in training
commonMistake: progress 通常不可数，不说 a progress 或 progresses；表示“取得进步”用 make progress。

example.english: Our team has made progress in passing the ball.
example.chinese: 我们队在传球方面有了进步。

application.prompt: The team has made good ___ in learning the new skill. (progress / progresses)
application.solution: progress。解析：progress 表示进步时通常不可数，不加复数 -es。

grammar: n. 比赛；竞赛；v. 相配；相称。作名词时可数，常说 play/win/lose a match。
collocations: a volleyball match；play a match；win or lose a match
commonMistake: match 作比赛时是可数名词；说一场比赛用 a match，不能漏掉冠词。

example.english: Our volleyball team has a match against Class Two on Friday.
example.chinese: 我们排球队星期五和二班有一场比赛。

application.prompt: Our volleyball team will play a ___ against Class Two on Friday. (match / energy)
application.solution: match。解析：两队之间的比赛是 a match。

grammar: n. 队；组。可数名词，常用 a team of + 人或物、team member、join a team。
collocations: a volleyball team；team member；join a team
commonMistake: team 是可数名词；单数前通常用 a/the 等限定词，成员可说 team members。

example.english: Our team practises together after school.
example.chinese: 我们队放学后一起训练。

application.prompt: A group of players who practise and compete together is a ___. (team / goal)
application.solution: team。解析：一起训练和比赛的一组队员叫 team。

grammar: pron. 我们的（所有物）。名词性物主代词，独立代替“our + 名词”，不直接放在名词前。
collocations: be ours；ours and theirs；a friend of ours
commonMistake: ours 后不直接接名词；说“我们的球队”用 our team，说“球队是我们的”用 ours。

example.english: Their gym is large, but ours is small.
example.chinese: 他们的体育馆很大，但我们的很小。

application.prompt: This ball belongs to us. It is ___. (ours / our)
application.solution: ours。解析：be 动词后独立表示“我们的”，用名词性物主代词 ours。

grammar: v. 输掉；丢失。过去式和过去分词均为 lost；常接比赛、物品等作宾语。
collocations: lose a match；lose a ball；lose a game
commonMistake: lose 的过去式和过去分词是 lost；lose（输掉、丢失）不要与 loose（松的）混淆。

example.english: Our team lost the final match by one point.
example.chinese: 我们队在决赛中以一分之差落败。

application.prompt: We did not win yesterday; we ___ the match. (lost / lose)
application.solution: lost。解析：yesterday 表示过去，lose 的过去式是 lost。

grammar: n. 青少年，通常指 13 至 19 岁的人；可数名词，复数 teenagers。
collocations: a teenager；teenage years；teenager club
commonMistake: teenager 通常指年龄以 -teen 结尾的人，约 13 至 19 岁；形容词形式是 teenage。

example.english: The sports centre has a club for teenagers.
example.chinese: 体育中心有一个青少年俱乐部。

application.prompt: A person aged 16, in the 13-to-19 age group, is a ___. (teenager / adult)
application.solution: teenager。解析：13 至 19 岁的人通常称为 teenager。

grammar: 专有名词，人名，史蒂夫。人名首字母大写；通常不加冠词。
collocations: Steve and his team；Steve’s racket；talk to Steve
commonMistake: 人名 Steve 的首字母必须大写；表示“史蒂夫的”可写 Steve’s。

example.english: Steve plays badminton with our class team.
example.chinese: 史蒂夫和我们班队一起打羽毛球。

application.prompt: My classmate’s name is ___. (Steve / steve)
application.solution: Steve。解析：人名属于专有名词，首字母要大写。
